title: W7 DRAFT (Agent 7, S4 #19 staging, 23:30; Agent 8 owns the final matrix): submission split + async submit on devoff4b+#19, s0 / s18 / s19 (+ optional s19h). Title/attract loop, no input needed
notes: SOURCE: S4-DRAFT.md L416 (W7: S4b with #18/#20; #19 rated and soaked; s0 / #18 / #18+#19 / #18+#19+#20; 1 + 4x4 = 17 runs, about 43 min; GPU Cmds and fps; #18 alone should tie, section 17 cond 6). Window fields copied from W5 (build/agent8/matrix/20261122-1756/matrix.json, the devoff precedent) with repeats 4. Corrected 11-23 09:04 (task #33): this note cited L391, and s18's note said 'S4-DRAFT section 17 cond 6'; it is b2r's section 17 cond 6 (perf-notes/agent10-batch2-review.md L799).

BIN: every arm on <DEVOFF4B-S4R1S2> = devoff4b + build/agent7/s4-r1s2/s4-r1s2.diff (full SDK rebuild; suggested dir build/agent2/devoff4b-s4r1s2-bin), staged only after Agent 10's rating, the functional rows and the 10-min soak pass (build/agent7/s4-r1s2/). One bin for all arms, so the arms differ only in kInitOnly cvars. Replace the placeholder in Agent 8's final copy.

N: <N> is the #18 split size chosen by Agent 3's ready-N gate (s4b10/s4b16 counters). s19h, if kept, uses <N/2> to test whether more, smaller chunks help (K, submissions per frame). Replace both placeholders in the final copy.

#20 ARM DROPPED: #20 step 1 is only a compile-time counters macro on another bin (devoff4b-ctr-bin, which perturbs Execute), and step 2 (the filter) is not staged, so the S4-DRAFT's 4th arm (#18+#19+#20) cannot run. Default: 3 arms, 1 cold + 3x4 = 13 runs, about 30-34 min. With the optional s19h: 17 runs, about 39-45 min. Alternative 4th arm: s0 on devoff4b-bin (the #19 OFF path's cost); not proposed, because that path adds only untaken branches and functional row (a) proves its logs.

KEYS: no env key in any arm (env {}), so nothing from build/agent8/w8w9/ENV-KEYS-F1.txt is needed. cvars only: framerate_limit=0 on every arm (uncapped, as in W5), d3d12_submit_split_kb (#18, kInitOnly, default 0) and d3d12_async_submit (#19, kInitOnly, default false).

PROOF PER RUN, checked before any fps is read (game.log): s0 has no 'd3d12_submit_split' and no 'd3d12_async_submit' line. s18 has 'd3d12_submit_split_kb: splitting submissions at <N> KB of deferred commands' and 'd3d12_submit_split: frame=... splits=... failed=0 ...' counter lines with splits rising, and no 'd3d12_async_submit' line. s19/s19h have the same two #18 lines plus 'd3d12_async_submit: submitting splits on the submit thread (3 slots)' and 'd3d12_async_submit: frame=... chunks=... queued_max=...' counter lines with chunks > 0 and queued_max <= 3; no 'needs d3d12_submit_split_kb above 0' WARN and no 'failed to create the submit thread' ERROR. threads.csv shows a 'D3D12 Submit' thread in s19/s19h runs only.

READ-OUT: primary = GPU Commands thread CPU ms per frame (threads.csv) and fps; then median ms and p99. Paired within-round deltas vs s0 (bench/agent7/w4b_readout/w4b_readout.py <dir> --all), and fps T-std / B-block with its guards (light share, raw GM delta with the pooled CI, host flags) from build/agent7/w4b-noise/readout.py <dir>. Expected: s18 ties s0 (section 17 cond 6); s19 moves ExecuteCommandLists/Signal of the splits to 'D3D12 Submit', so GPU Commands ms/f drops by about that thread's ms/f; fps rises only if GPU Commands is the limiter. drain_wait_us and full_wait_us per frame (from the counter lines) say how much of the gain the drains give back.

VALIDITY: a timed verdict needs busy < 0.97 in the scored runs. Runs in the slow state (sys.csv E-core MHz < 800 for >= 3 rows; bench/agent8/run/matrix_recheck.py --drop-slow, bench/agent11/timerq_slowstate.ps1) are dropped or scored only up to the onset. Light-phase runs are excluded as in W5.
PRE-FLIGHT: run-matrix.ps1 -PlanOnly on the final copy (about 1 min), then one functional queue row with -Quick -NoCold -Repeats 1 (3-4 runs, about 6-9 min) whose proof lines match the PROOF note.

Timing comes only from the double-click run on the unlocked desktop (screensaver None, AC power, hands off). Agent runs of this matrix (-Quick, hidden desktop) are functional only. No d3d12_debug, trace toggles or counters build in any arm.

arms.note: s0 = reference: #18 and #19 both off (their defaults, set explicitly for the record). No split or async line in game.log
s18 = #18 alone (split at <N> KB, submitted on GPU Commands as in stage 1). Should tie s0 (b2r section 17 cond 6). Proof: the split INIT and counter lines, no async line

s19 = #18 + #19 (splits at <N> KB submitted on the 'D3D12 Submit' thread, 3-slot FIFO). Proof: the split lines plus the async INIT and counter lines (chunks > 0, queued_max <= 3), no WARN/ERROR async line
OPTIONAL (drop with -Only s0,s18,s19): s19 at half the split size, about 2x the chunks per frame. Tests whether the gain grows with K or the drains eat it
